title: Telangana launches Indiramma Housing scheme in Hyderabad; releases eligibility, application procedure, beneficiary contribution details
description: The flats with built up area of 528 sft will be built in multi-storey towers. While Telangana government would provide subsidy of ₹5 lakh, tentative contribution of beneficiary is ₹6 lakh. A flat will be spread over 400 sft.
